name: Cislunar-Firth
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, impact-scarred wastelands emerge like the bones of the planet.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
For traders, rare flora and silicon alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
